dueDate.title: Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dueDate.description: Due date for tasks. 'tomorrow' = +1 day, 'this week' = Friday, 'next week' = next Monday, 'next month' = first of next month. Default = 3 business days from today.

followUpActions.title: Follow-Up Actions
followUpActions.description: Comma-separated list of ALL follow-up commitments. Be specific and actionable. E.g. 'Send Keytruda KEYNOTE-189 data to Dr. Sharma, Arrange CME at Apollo next month, Call back Friday to confirm formulary decision'.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: High / Normal / Low. Use High only if the rep says urgent or ASAP. Default Normal.
